question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **lethargic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lethargic** means laziness or lack of energy.

 
 
• **Example -** *He felt too miserable and **lethargic** to get dressed.*
 
 
 
• ​Here in the given paragraph, **'lethargic'** is used to describe that **Rock pythons are very lazy and they only move when they search for food or when they feel threatened by something.**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'lethargic'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Python snake, also known as Ajgar, is one of the most (1) __**massively**__ built snakes of the Indian subcontinent. It belongs to the Boidae family and is (2) __**dependent**__ on water to quite an extent. One of the (3) __**unique**__ features of the Rock pythons of India is that they can raise their body temperature above the ambient level (4) **__through__** muscular contractions. Rock python is a **(5) **__**lethargic**__ creature, moving only while hunting or when threatened.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Antic** means strange and unusual, especially in a silly or very energetic way.
 
• **Classic** means something that's very high in quality.
 
• **Exotic **means unusual and exciting because of coming or seeming to come from far away.
